name: Meadowbrook Free Will Baptist
addr: 204 Blue Ridge Rd, Black Mountain, NC 28711

reviews.t: Meadowbrook has such kind people. Everyone feels like family, and they love the Lord. It is an honor to serve the community with the people of Meadowbrook. There are lots of ways to connect. If you're looking for a church, come and visit!
Very welcoming... The pastor is very welcoming and caring/ they have a nice spot to take a dip n cool off
What a great Bible-believing church. Pastor Daryl is a great teacher, preacher, and leader.
Very friendly folks! Preaches the Gospel every Sunday... Come see you won't be disappointed!
Great Church to be a member of. They treat each other respectfully and like family.
I love this church and the wonderful loving people there.
Great place to worship friendly people
